subject: maths
question: Sharad can complete a piece of work alone in 13 days and Varad can complete the same piece of work alone in 9 days. They started the work together, but Varad had to leave 11 days before the completion of the work. In how many days will the work complete?
solution:
**Given:**

Sharad can complete work in 13 days

Varad can complete work in 9 days

Varad leaves 11 days before completion

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of 13 and 9

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Total work ÷ (Sharad’s work + Varad’s work for initial period + Sharad’s remaining work)

**Calculations:**

LCM of 13 and 9 = 117 units

⇒ Sharad’s 1-day work = 117 ÷ 13 = 9 units

⇒ Varad’s 1-day work = 117 ÷ 9 = 13 units

Let total time = x days

Varad works for (x - 11) days

Total work = Sharad’s contribution + Varad’s contribution

⇒ 117 = (9 × x) + (13 × (x - 11))

⇒ 117 = 9x + 13x - 143

⇒ 117 + 143 = 22x

⇒ 260 = 22x

⇒ x = 260 ÷ 22

⇒ x = 130 ÷ 11 = 130/11

**∴ The work will complete in 11(9)/(11) days.**
